presentation.manual_preparation: Choose and check your own exact Resident Evil Gaiden (USA) original. Portcove installs the unchanged official Windows package, creates its local saves folder and manages local saves and settings. Review the resolved Windows account-wide preferences path before installation: the game may overwrite it and discard unknown entries, affecting other copies. Portcove never owns or backs up that shared file. A local runtime_prefs.ini fallback belongs to this managed installation. Existing external copies remain yours to manage. Use printable ASCII paths within Windows MAX_PATH bounds. Gameplay remains untested. MIT and clean-room claims are attributed upstream assertions, not blanket redistribution permission.
